get_flight_status.description: Get status, estimated departure, gate and delay reason for one flight on one date. Read-only. Returns not_found if the flight doesn't operate that day.

date.description: Operating date at the hub, ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
date.title: Date

flight_number.description: Flight number: carrier code ZZ then digits, e.g. ZZ214.
flight_number.title: Flight Number

get_flight_status.name: get_flight_status

issue_voucher.description: Issue a meal or hotel voucher to one booking on a disrupted flight. Irreversible: issued vouchers can be spent at once. Above 150 EUR, returns approval_required and a person decides. One voucher per booking, flight and kind: a repeat returns the original voucher. Supports dry run.

flight_number.description: The disrupted flight: carrier code ZZ then digits, e.g. ZZ247.
flight_number.title: Flight Number

issue_voucher.name: issue_voucher

list_departures.description: List departures from the hub for one date, optionally to one destination, five per page; pass next_cursor to get the next page. Read-only. Returns flight number, destination, scheduled time and status; use get_flight_status for gates, estimates and reasons.

cursor.description: Opaque page token: pass next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

date.description: Operating date at the hub, ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
date.title: Date

destination.description: Optional IATA destination code, three letters, e.g. SIN. Omit for all.
destination.title: Destination

list_departures.name: list_departures

notify_passengers.description: Send one SMS and email to every passenger booked on a flight. Irreversible: messages can't be recalled. Within one disruption, repeating the same message for the same flight returns the original result instead of sending again. Supports dry run.

flight_number.description: Flight number: carrier code ZZ then digits, e.g. ZZ214.
flight_number.title: Flight Number

message.description: Text sent by SMS and email to every booked passenger. Plain text, at most 320 characters.
message.title: Message

reason.description: Why passengers are being told: delay, gate_change, cancellation or diversion.
reason.title: Reason

notify_passengers.name: notify_passengers
